context: Two friends watch a tennis tournament on TV, dissecting the final
purpose: Teach: 山田/低く/背中/ラスト/コート/ヒント/店長/争い

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おっ、ラストセットだ。山田選手、フォーム崩れてないな。
lines.en: Oh, it's the last set. Yamada hasn't lost his form.
lines.style: Casual excited commentary, dropping particles like a guy watching sports with a friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でも相手も強いっすよ。完全に優勝争いって感じ。
lines.en: But the opponent's strong too. It feels like a full championship battle.
lines.style: Teen boy using casual っす ending, animated and engaged.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見ろよ、構えが低くなった。コートの後ろまで下がってる。
lines.en: Look, his stance got lower. He's backed up to the rear of the court.
lines.style: Pointing at screen, observational tone with short emphatic sentences.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 背中、ちょっと曲がってません?疲れてるのかも。
lines.en: His back's a bit hunched, isn't it? Maybe he's tired.
lines.style: Polite uncertainty toward older friend, observant remark with rising intonation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あー、ニュース速報の見出しで読んだけど、現時点で第二シードらしい。
lines.en: Ah, I read in the news headline that he's currently the second seed.
lines.style: Sharing trivia mid-watch, relaxed informative aside between rallies.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ。あ、今のショット、何かのヒントになりそう。俺もテニスのフォーム直したいんすよね。
lines.en: Huh. Oh, that shot just now could be a hint for me. I want to fix my tennis form too.
lines.style: Genuine teen interest, mixing admiration with personal aspiration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういや、バイトの店長もテニスやってるって言ってたな。今度教わってみたら?
lines.en: Come to think of it, my part-time boss said he plays tennis. Maybe get him to teach you?
lines.style: Casual suggestion, conversational shift while keeping eyes on screen.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジっすか!うわ、決まった!山田、最高っす!
lines.en: Seriously?! Whoa, he nailed it! Yamada, you're the best!
lines.style: Explosive teen excitement reacting to a winning point, voice raised.
